jobs.name: Coffee Break Title
jobs.prompt: 16-bit pixel art title screen, SNES game style, visible pixels, no smoothing. Cozy hilltop terrace cafe at golden sunrise, misty valley and mountains in background. Game title 'DOG TRAVEL' in bold pixel font centered at top with lime #baf122 glow. Subtitle 'by Hack Your Way' below in clean geometric sans-serif font. Two separate game characters shown: on left side young man with messy brown hair, round glasses, lime green hoodie holding coffee cup with golden retriever beside him. On right side young woman with long wavy dark brown hair, arm tattoos, lime green hoodie holding coffee with cream-white border collie beside her. Characters standing apart as two playable heroes, not a couple. Steam rising from cups. Centered composition for 1.91:1 crop. Color palette: lime #baf122, red #ff3131, purple #5e17eb, black. 16:9 widescreen.
